title: BPMN activities, extracted (smart-trust-tools)
description: Candidate terms extracted from every BPMN task and call activity: `name` as the label, its own `<documentation>` as the definition, the element id as the code. Generated by folio-assistant-core/scripts/glossary-extract.ts; not curated, and never hand-edited: a person promotes a term by authoring it in a glossary of their own.

terms.prefLabel: Change the WIT or CDDL and regenerate its views
terms.definition: Change api/wit or api/cddl, then run wit2kotlin, gen-api-types and, if a logical model moved, fetch-lms and lm-derive. Nothing generated is edited by hand.

terms.prefLabel: Check the graph and publish the site
terms.definition: Run check-req-nodes, then publish gh-pages with stage-local: main to the root, a branch to STAGING.

terms.prefLabel: Amend the requirements within the architecture rules
terms.definition: Change the req: nodes in skills/requirements/ within the architecture rules (one contract, a synchronous core with no I/O, open standards only), citing the changed source by reference.

terms.prefLabel: Test against the shared vectors
terms.definition: Run check-models and the hcert-core tests on the JVM and Node against the shared vectors.

terms.prefLabel: Assemble and validate the payload
terms.definition: Build the payload and validate it against its logical model (DVCMin, or the VHL payload), keeping elements the library does not know.

terms.prefLabel: Encode as Base45
terms.definition: Encode the compressed bytes as RFC 9285 Base45, the alphabet QR Alphanumeric mode stores compactly.

terms.prefLabel: Build the CWT claim set
terms.definition: Wrap the payload in a CWT claim set: iss, iat, exp inside the DSC's validity, and the payload at hcert (-260) under its subclaim.

terms.prefLabel: Compress with ZLIB
terms.definition: Compress the COSE_Sign1 with ZLIB/DEFLATE, after signing, never before.

terms.prefLabel: Serialise as deterministic CBOR
terms.definition: Serialise the claim set as RFC 8949 deterministic CBOR, so the same claims always give the same bytes.

terms.prefLabel: Attach the signature as COSE_Sign1
terms.definition: Attach the returned signature to make the COSE_Sign1, checking it is the length the algorithm gives (64 bytes for ES256, r||s).

terms.prefLabel: Prefix HC1:
terms.definition: Prefix the context identifier HC1: to make the QR-ready string.

terms.prefLabel: Prepare the Sig_structure
terms.definition: Build the COSE Sig_structure from the protected header (alg, kid = SHA-256 of the DSC, first 8 bytes) and the payload, and hand its bytes out to be signed.

terms.prefLabel: Render the QR code (Alphanumeric, EC Q)
terms.definition: The application renders the HC1 string as a QR code in Alphanumeric mode, error correction Q, with its own QR encoder.

terms.prefLabel: Select the payload type and subclaim
terms.definition: Choose the logical model and the hcert subclaim for the use case from the registry QR Code Generation 2 defines: a DVC (key -6) when the certificate must verify offline, a VHL (key 5) when the records are larger than a QR code holds.

terms.prefLabel: Sign the bytes with the DSC key
terms.definition: The key holder signs the Sig_structure bytes with the DSC private key (ES256, or PS256) and returns the raw signature. The key never leaves it.

terms.prefLabel: Check signature, key usage, CWT and time; dispatch the payload
terms.definition: Verify the signature with each candidate, then the DSC's key usage for this payload type, the CWT's iat and exp against now, and dispatch the payload by subclaim. Every failure is a value naming its step and reason.

terms.prefLabel: Strip HC1:, Base45-decode and inflate
terms.definition: Strip HC1: (refusing any other context), Base45-decode strictly and inflate within a size limit.

terms.prefLabel: Find every trusted DSC with the kid
terms.definition: Find every DSC in the host's trust list whose kid matches; more than one may, and each is tried.

terms.prefLabel: Parse COSE_Sign1 and validate the protected header
terms.definition: Parse the COSE_Sign1 within depth and size limits and check the protected header: a known alg, and a kid of 8 bytes.

terms.prefLabel: Generate the link key and encrypt each document
terms.definition: Generate a 32-byte random key for the link and encrypt each document as JWE compact, dir / A256GCM.

terms.prefLabel: Issue the VHL payload as an HCERT (key 5, CBOR map)
terms.definition: Issue the VHL payload (url, key, exp, flag, label) as a CBOR map at HCERT key 5, signed like any HCERT.

terms.prefLabel: Read the manifest Bundle and decrypt each document
terms.definition: Read the searchset Bundle the sharer returns and decrypt each document with the link key, accepting zip DEF.

terms.prefLabel: Build and sign the ITI-YY5 manifest request
terms.definition: Build the ITI-YY5 request: POST <url>/List/_search with the form body (passcode only when the P flag is set), its Content-Digest and its RFC 9421 HTTP Message Signature. The host sends it over mutual TLS.

terms.prefLabel: Verify the VHL HCERT and its exp
terms.definition: Verify the VHL as an HCERT, and refuse a link whose exp has passed.
